verdict.rationale: LlamaParse applies AI to user documents: agentic parsing, extraction, classification, and AI-generated extraction schemas from a prompt. One community user also notes table numbers were reachable through question-answering in the interface. However, this is mainly AI-powered data transformation rather than in-product insights or suggestions, and the Q&A and agent examples are developer-built RAG apps on a deprecated Index. Missing for 10: a documented in-product insights or analytics feature, proactive AI suggestions about the user's data, a non-deprecated in-UI Q&A capability, and independent corroboration.
